messages:
Anya: Kicked off FP8 kernel enablement canary for glint-13b on H100 + L40S. Using fp8-fused runtime build. Early perf looks great (tokens/s +18%) but seeing a small QA regression on long-context SQuAD-like evals, also a handful of NaN fallbacks in logs.
metrics-bot: Canary summary (glint-13b, fp8-fused, 10% canary): EM -0.6% vs baseline, avg latency 42ms -> 35ms, p99 120ms -> 98ms, token cost -22%. Fallback rate: 0.03% (NaN -> int8).
Sam: Hmm. NaN fallback + small EM hit usually smells like kv scaling / tiling handshake mismatch when kernels switch between H100/L40S codepaths. Did you see any kv norm deltas at tile boundaries?
Carlos: Also check compile flags between h100 and l40s artifacts (FAST_MATH / tensor_core flags). Rounding/accum differences can show up as tiny activ drift that compounds across long prefixes.
Anya: Ran a quick kv-tiling-check locally. Snippet:
```
[tiling-check] seq=2048 tile=256 kv_norm_delta=4.3e-03
[tiling-check] seq=2049 tile=256 kv_norm_delta=1.2e-02  <-- suspicious
[tiling-check] seq=4096 tile=512 kv_norm_delta=3.9e-04
```
Looks like spikes at certain seq boundaries. Can reproduce on L40S-only too (so not purely cross-device), but amplitude bigger when H100 path is involved.
Eva: I recommend adding a quick canary assertion: compare key/value norms at tile handoff and abort or fallback if delta > 1e-3. Also try toggling per-channel scaling for fp8 (we've seen that reduce drift).
Sam: Quick try: flip these envs and repro: `FP8_PER_CHANNEL_SCALING=1` and `DISABLE_KERNEL_HANDSHAKE=1`. If disabling the handshake removes the regression, handshake logic likely mis-aligns scaling state.
Carlos: If handshake disable helps, we can attempt a smaller fix: persist scaling tensor across handshake instead of recomputing per tile. Also consider a temporary rollout policy with auto-fallback to INT8/AWQ for effected routes.
Anya: Patch idea: keep a rolling scaling buffer and compare with recomputed scale before commit. I'll bisect to the kernel patch and run `kv-tiling-check --verbose` across seqs.
Eva: Rollout snippet you can use: 
```
rollout apply --model glint-13b --canary 0.1 --fp8-kernel enable --fallback int8,awq --preflight kv-tiling-check
```
Sam: Good call to preflight. If we still see EM delta after handshake fix, we should run AWQ/GPTQ quant baselines to check whether quantization choice interacts with fp8 drift.
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10% due to quality alert (EM regression). Auto-rollback scheduled in 2h if no resolution. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Anya: On it — starting bisect now, will push a hotfix candidate to disable recompute-on-handshake and report back in ~45m. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
